### The Real First Thanksgiving
Author: Rick Warren
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-hope-with-rick-warren/daily-hope-with-rick-warren-november-22-2023.html
Passage: Deuteronomy 16:10
Points:
- Long before modern holidays, God instituted the Feast of Weeks as an annual festival of gratitude.
- Believers are called to bring freewill offerings directly proportional to how the Lord has blessed them.
- Giving should consist of the first fruits of our resources rather than the leftovers.
- Generous giving expresses thankfulness for past and present provision while stepping out in faith for the future.
- Faithful generosity reflects the character of God, who promises to supply the needs of those who trust Him.
